scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the red flag
scenarios.hook: Lights out, Leclerc into the wall at the Parabolica on lap 2 — yellow, Safety Car, red flag, and the whole field files into the pits.

events.title: RED FLAG
events.body: Leclerc and Hamilton touched at the first chicane on the opening lap. A lap later Leclerc hit the wall at the Parabolica — yellow flags, then the Safety Car, then a red flag at 15:07 local. The field parked in the pit lane for half an hour before the race resumed with a standing restart. In this replay Leclerc's car seems to drive on after the impact: that is his failing telemetry feed, not the car, which stopped at the wall.

provenance.note: Known data artifact: LEC's telemetry fails at the Parabolica impact (~2:50 into the window). The half-lap ‘limp’ before his car halts is the dead feed, not the car — constant ~160 km/h with throttle stuck at zero — which stopped at the wall.

scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the restart
scenarios.hook: The field forms up on the grid for a standing restart — lights out again at 1:20 in, then three green laps of scramble, Antonelli climbing.

scenarios.title: Silverstone 2024 · the rain arrives
